summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running tests, per the instructions; the test suite is unverified. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (before width) and yields one Text with click spans last; Opacity merges the blended color into the existing style so meta survives; new docs/reference/tabs.md; new tests/widgets/test_tabs.py (plus __init__.py) and appended bar tests in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py. Layout resolver needed no change because the edge already had size, min_size, and fraction. Judgment calls: the bar position uses the displayed index rather than the full-list index so duplicate names place the underline correctly; zero-width labels are excluded from the resolver because size 0 counts as flexible; Tab names default only when name is None; the sandbox demo was skipped. Nothing was committed.
